item.title: Former president of China's SIIC group given death penalty with two- year reprieve
item.description: Zhou Jun, former president of China's Shanghai Industrial Investment (Holdings) Company Limited (SIIC), was sentenced to the death penalty with a two-year reprieve due to corruption, a Shanghai court ruled on Friday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Zhou Jun, former president of China's Shanghai Industrial Investment (Holdings) Company Limited (SIIC), was sentenced to the death penalty with a two-year reprieve due to corruption, a Shanghai court ruled on Friday. His sentence will be commuted to life in prison unless he commits crimes during the two-year reprieve period.

item.title: Harbour Energy's top shareholder further cuts stake to 16% in discounted share sale
item.description: Harbour Energy's top shareholder BASF has once again reduced its stake in the British oil and gas producer, in what is the largest-ever block sale of Harbour shares, sending the stock down more than 3%.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Harbour Energy's (HBR.L) top shareholder BASF (BASFn.DE) has once again reduced its stake in the British oil and gas producer, in what is the largest-ever block sale of Harbour shares, sending the stock down more than 3%. Here are some details: The German chemicals group sold about 133 million ordinary shares in Harbour at £2.66 apiece, a 4.3% discount to the stock's closing price on Thursday. It sold 80 million Harbour shares to institutional investors and agreed to sell 53 million ordinary shares to Harbour, with the buyback worth about $190 million. Once the share sale is completed, BASF's interest in Harbour Energy's is expected to reduce to 16.4% from about 24.3%. BASF had [USN:L4N40F0EV TEXT:"previously"] sold about 80 million Harbour shares at discounted prices in March.

item.title: Marruecos rechaza las acusaciones sobre el paso fronterizo de Ceuta
item.description: El Ministerio de Asuntos Exteriores de Marruecos dijo el jueves que no había pruebas que demostraran la implicación de Rabat en el cruce masivo hacia el enclave español de Ceuta en julio, y añadió que rechazaba estar siendo arrastrado a las disputas políticas internas de España.
item.dc:creator: Ahmed Eljechtimi
item.content:encoded: El Ministerio de Asuntos Exteriores de Marruecos dijo el jueves que no había pruebas que demostraran la implicación de Rabat en el cruce masivo hacia el enclave español de Ceuta en julio, y añadió que rechazaba estar siendo arrastrado a las disputas políticas internas de España. Más de 70.000 personas cruzaron de Marruecos a Ceuta, lo que avivó [USN:L6N44Z0HC TEXT:"las críticas"] en España tanto hacia Rabat como hacia el presidente del Gobierno, Pedro Sánchez. Aunque la mayoría ya ha regresado, más de 100 fallecieron, según las ONG. Las autoridades locales afirman que miles de personas, entre ellas menores no acompañados, permanecen en el enclave, viviendo en campamentos improvisados o en las calles y playas, lo que alimenta protestas casi diarias por parte de los residentes, indignados por la gestión de la crisis por parte del Gobierno español. Desde entonces, los partidos de la oposición en España han puesto en el punto de mira la relación del Gobierno de Pedro Sánchez con Marruecos y han acusado a Rabat de facilitar u orquestar la entrada masiva. "¿Por qué seguir lanzando acusaciones contra Marruecos cuando no hay pruebas, hechos ni informes que demuestren ninguna implicación por parte de las autoridades marroquíes?", señaló el ministerio en un comunicado. "¿Por qué no se está repatriando a los migrantes ilegales, a pesar de que el Gobierno marroquí se ha comprometido oficialmente a readmitirlos? ¿Por qué se mantiene a los menores no acompañados separados de sus familias, cuando Marruecos ha solicitado urgentemente su retorno?", señaló el ministerio. [USN:L6N45116X TEXT:"Los informes"] publicados por el Gobierno español el miércoles revelaron que los servicios de inteligencia y seguridad españoles habían advertido tanto a Madrid como a sus homólogos marroquíes sobre la posibilidad de una travesía masiva. "Marruecos se niega a ser utilizado como peón político en el periodo preelectoral, ni acepta que se le convierta en chivo expiatorio en ajustes de cuentas políticos", dijo el ministerio. Las elecciones generales en España están previstas para mediados de 2027. El ministerio destacó la estrecha cooperación en materia de seguridad, migración y economía establecida entre Rabat y Madrid desde que Sánchez respaldó en 2022 el plan de autonomía de Marruecos para el Sáhara Occidental. Marruecos no reconoce la soberanía española sobre Ceuta ni sobre el otro enclave de Melilla.

item.title: China limits fuel price increases for third time since Iran war began
item.description: China has capped increases in retail prices for transportation fuels for the third time since the Iran war began to mitigate the impact of rising international oil prices on the domestic market, the state planner said in a statement on Friday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: China has capped increases in retail prices for transportation fuels for the third time since the Iran war began to mitigate the impact of rising international oil prices on the domestic market, the state planner said in a statement on Friday. Retail prices for gasoline and diesel will rise by 260 yuan ($38.76) and 250 yuan per metric ton, respectively, effective September 12. Under China’s scheduled pricing mechanism, the increases would have been 435 yuan and 420 yuan, respectively, the statement said. After the adjustment, gasoline and diesel retail prices will be 19% and 21% higher, respectively, than the levels set in the last adjustment before the Iran war began. ($1 = 6.7087 Chinese yuan renminbi)

item.title: Western athletes try their hand at Kyrgyzstan’s Nomad Games
item.description: Clutching a bow and arrow and riding helmet in a remote gorge in northern Kyrgyzstan, London-based executive coach Becca Sweetman is a long way from home.
item.dc:creator: Felix Light
item.content:encoded: Clutching a bow and arrow and riding helmet in a remote gorge in northern Kyrgyzstan, London-based executive coach Becca Sweetman is a long way from home. "About eight years ago a friend asked if I wanted to have a go at horseback archery and I just got hooked on this amazing sport," she said. "So, I've been competing for the last eight years for the Great Britain team." Sweetman is one of many Western athletes to make the trek out to Central Asia for the Nomad Games, a biannual tournament of traditional nomad sports, mostly originating from Central Asia. Aside from horse archery, they include various styles of wrestling, falconry, and traditional board games. Since the inaugural edition in 2014, the Nomad Games have gone from strength to strength. This year they returned home to Kyrgyzstan, the mountainous Central Asian country of seven million where they were first held, and where traditional sports retain a strong popular following. More than 3,000 athletes from more than 100 countries took part, organisers said. An opening ceremony in the Kyrgyz capital, Bishkek, [USN:L8N44S1C3 TEXT:"was attended by leaders"] including Russian President Vladimir Putin, Turkish President Tayyip Erdogan, and India's Narendra Modi, in town for a summit of the Shanghai Cooperation Organisation. Sam Pollard, a London-based consultant, came to Kyrgyzstan as part of the British tug of war team. He said he'd become interested in the Nomad Games after seeing videos of Kok Boru, a nomadic sport similar to polo, but which is played with a sheep carcass in place of a ball. "That looks awesome," he told himself. The timing of the games aligned perfectly with when he wanted to visit Central Asia, plus he and his friends "had a bit of background in tug of war," he said. Although many athletes have come from countries without a history of nomadism, others come from countries like Mongolia and the Central Asian republics, where nomadic sports retain a major following. "These games have the nomadic spirit," said Mumina Daminova, a horseback archer from Uzbekistan, who competed in flowing white traditional robes. "It's like Olympic games but for ethnosport," she said.

item.title: France-L'économie n'est pas dans un état catastrophique, mais il faut réduire le déficit - Moulin
item.description: L'économie française n'est pas dans une situation catastrophique mais le gouvernement doit agir pour réduire le déficit public du pays, a déclaré vendredi Emmanuel Moulin, le gouverneur de la Banque de France (BdF).
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: L'économie française n'est pas dans une situation catastrophique mais le gouvernement doit agir pour réduire le déficit public du pays, a déclaré vendredi Emmanuel Moulin, le gouverneur de la Banque de France (BdF). Alors que [USN:L8N45115V TEXT:"Matignon"] est à la recherche de 30 milliards d'euros d'économies avec l'objectif difficilement tenable d'un déficit du produit intérieur brut (PIB) à 4,9%, le tout avec une révision à la baisse de la [USN:S8N3ZK00P TEXT:"prévision"] croissance économique pour 2026, Emmanuel Moulin a estimé que la France disposait cependant encore de nombreux atouts. "Je pense qu'effectivement, il y a une inquiétude aujourd'hui, parce qu'il y a des choses qu'il faut traiter, en particulier la question des finances publiques et du déficit budgétaire", a-t-il déclaré sur RTL "Il faut réduire le déficit budgétaire. Mais après l'économie française, elle a des atouts, elle a une énergie qui n'est pas chère, elle a une économie diversifiée, on a une industrie qui repart dans des secteurs qui sont porteurs comme par exemple les data centers, la défense, l'aéronautique", a-t-il ajouté. "Et donc ce n'est pas totalement catastrophique. Mais je pense qu'il faut agir", a-t-il insisté. Ces propos interviennent au lendemain de la décision de la Banque centrale européenne ([USN:L8N4521LV TEXT:"BCE"]) de relever de nouveau ses taux directeurs, ce qui renchérit le coût du crédit, tandis que l'[USN:S8N3ZK00P TEXT:"Insee"] de son côté a annoncé jeudi tabler désormais sur une croissance économique pour la France de 0,4% pour cette année, contre une estimation précédente de +0,7%. Le gouvernement a également retenu à ce stade une prévision de PIB pour 2026 de 0,7% et une actualisation à la baisse de cette projection est attendue ce vendredi. Pour Emmanuel Moulin, comme les autres pays développés, l'économie française a fait face au premier semestre au choc lié à la guerre au Moyen-Orient et à l'augmentation des prix de l'énergie. "Nous avons subi (également) un choc sur la filière aéronautique et celle-là, elle est très importante sur Airbus au premier trimestre puisque Airbus n'a pas pu recevoir les moteurs pour équiper ses avions", a-t-il également noté, soulignant que cela a freiné les exportations. "Et puis au deuxième trimestre, nous avons eu la canicule", a-t-il également expliqué. S'agissant de la dette de la France qui dépasse désormais les 3.600 milliards d'euros, soit 118% du PIB, et pour laquelle certains partis d'opposition comme la France Insoumise (LFI), proposent de l'annuler en partie, Emmanuel Moulin a jugé qu'une tel dispositif serait "illégal, dangereux et inutile". Candidat à l'élection présidentielle française de l'an prochain, le dirigeant de LFI Jean-Luc Mélenchon a plaidé pour l'annulation de 18% de la dette française, la part détenue par la Banque de France, affirmant que cette mesure permettrait d'accroître les dépenses sociales. "Ce sont des traités que nous avons signés, que nous avons ratifiés, qui ont été ratifiés par référendum par le peuple français. Donc effectivement, si le point, c'est de sortir de la zone euro, parce que c'est ça que ça veut dire, ça veut dire qu'on ne peut plus fonctionner au sein de la zone euro", a noté Emmanuel Moulin. "C'est une copropriété, donc si on ne paye pas les charges de copropriété, les autres propriétaires vont nous dire les amis vous allez sortir", a ajouté le gouverneur de la BdF.

item.title: Auto-Les USA et le reste du monde divergent clairement-Stellantis
item.description: Le directeur général de Stellantis , Antonio Filosa, a souligné jeudi soir au cours d'une conférence d'analystes l'ampleur de la divergence actuelle au sein des marchés automobiles mondiaux, entre les Etats-Unis et partout ailleurs.
item.dc:creator: Nora Eckert
item.content:encoded: Le directeur général de Stellantis (STLAM.MI) , Antonio Filosa, a souligné jeudi soir au cours d'une conférence d'analystes l'ampleur de la divergence actuelle au sein des marchés automobiles mondiaux, entre les Etats-Unis et partout ailleurs. Le groupe automobile franco-italo-américain doit naviguer dans un contexte politique et commercial américain de plus en plus divergent par rapport aux autres régions du monde, dont l'Europe, en particulier sur la manière dont les constructeurs automobile mondiaux peuvent appréhender des partenariats avec des acteurs chinois, a-t-il ajouté. "Nous voyons clairement que le monde est divisé en deux choses: une, ce sont les Etats-Unis (...) et puis nous avons le reste du monde", a dit Antonio Filosa à une conférence organisée par Jefferies. Un des défis pour Stellantis et ses concurrents est de développer des véhicules pour le marché américain, d'où proviennent la majeure partie des bénéfices, alors que la réglementation et la demande des consommateurs y sont très différentes des autres marchés mondiaux. Aux Etats-Unis, le groupe né de la fusion entre PSA et FCA s'appuie uniquement sur une ingénierie et un développement local, a poursuivi Antonio Filosa, tandis que sur les autres marchés, comme l'Europe, il a recours a des partenariats avec des constructeurs automobiles chinois, tels Leapmotor (9863.HK) et Dongfeng (600006.SS) . Si dans le cadre de ces partenariats, aucun modèle n'est prévu pour les Etats-Unis, a ajouté le directeur général de Stellantis, des accords similaires passés par d'autres constructeurs automobiles sont dans le viseur de l'administration Trump, comme la co-entreprise entre Ford Motor (F.N) et le chinois Geely (0175.HK) en Europe. L'administration Trump accuse ce type de partenariat de soutenir l'expansion globale des constructeurs automobiles chinois, tandis que Ford y voit une nécessaire adaptation à la nouvelle réalité du monde et un moyen de devenir plus léger et plus agile à travers ces partenariats.

item.title: BOURSE L'Europe ouvre dans le vert, tente un rebond après la BCE
item.description: Les principales Bourses européennes sont dans le vert en début de séance vendredi, tentant un rebond après une clôture en baisse la veille en réaction au ton offensif de la Banque centrale européenne.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Les principales Bourses européennes sont dans le vert en début de séance vendredi, tentant un rebond après une clôture en baisse la veille en réaction au ton offensif de la Banque centrale européenne. À Paris, le CAC 40 (.FCHI) gagne 0,54% à 8.160,29 points vers 07h15 GMT. À Francfort, le Dax (.GDAXI) avance de 0,38% et à Londres, le FTSE 100 (.FTSE) cède 0,04%. L'indice EuroStoxx 50 (.STOXX50E) progresse de 0,48%, le FTSEurofirst 300 (.FTEU3) de 0,28% et le Stoxx 600 (.STOXX) de 0,27%. Sans surprise, la Banque centrale européenne (BCE) a relevé jeudi ses taux directeurs pour la deuxième fois cette année, tout en révisant à la hausse ses prévisions d'inflation pour 2027. Alors que ce relèvement était largement anticipé par les marchés, la révision à la hausse des prévisions d'inflation laisse présager un impact prolongé de la flambée des coûts énergétiques sur les prix. Les responsables de la Banque centrale européenne (BCE) prévoient un nouveau resserrement de la politique monétaire dans les mois à venir pour lutter contre l'inflation en zone euro et pourraient prendre de nouvelles mesures dès octobre, [USN:L6N45213P TEXT:"ont déclaré"] deux sources à Reuters. En parallèle, la pression reste accrue sur les cours pétroliers, les Houthis renforçant leur emprise sur le détroit de Bab el-Mandeb. Le Brent perd 2,08% à 105,39 dollars le baril après avoir atteint son plus haut niveau depuis quatre mois, à 109,97 dollars le baril. Aux valeurs, Alstom (ALSO.PA) gagne 1,8% après [USN:FWN4520ZU TEXT:"avoir signé"] avec TransPennine Express des contrats d'une valeur de 1,2 milliard d'euros pour la fourniture et la maintenance à long terme d’une flotte de trains électriques à batterie en Grande-Bretagne. Genfit (GNFT.PA) progresse de 3,5% au lendemain de [USN:FWN4520NT TEXT:"l'annonce"] de son intégration dans le SBF 120. Avio (AVI.MI) gagne 7% après que le fabricant italien de fusées a annoncé jeudi que son résultat opérationnel ajusté du premier semestre avait progressé de 7,3% sur un an.

item.title: La economía francesa no corre peligro, pero hay que reducir el déficit, afirma el banco central
item.description: El gobernador del Banco Central de Francia, Emmanuel Moulin, dijo el viernes que Francia no se encontraba ante un peligro económico catastrófico, pero que el Gobierno debía tomar medidas para reducir el déficit público del país.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: El gobernador del Banco Central de Francia, Emmanuel Moulin, dijo el viernes que Francia no se encontraba ante un peligro económico catastrófico, pero que el Gobierno debía tomar medidas para reducir el déficit público del país. Moulin hizo estas declaraciones después de que el INSEE revisara a la baja el jueves sus previsiones económicas para la segunda mayor economía de la zona del euro, pronosticando un crecimiento de apenas el 0,4% para este año. Moulin citó varios factores, como una ola de calor mortal y los problemas en Airbus. El instituto nacional de estadística francés había pronosticado anteriormente un crecimiento del 0,7% para 2026, por debajo de la expansión del 0,9% registrada el año pasado. "No diría que (la economía) esté en peligro, pero se encuentra en una situación preocupante e insatisfactoria", dijo Moulin a la emisora de radio RTL. "Tenemos que reducir el déficit presupuestario. Pero, más allá de eso, la economía francesa tiene sus puntos fuertes. Cuenta con energía barata y una economía diversificada. Estamos asistiendo a un repunte industrial en sectores prometedores como los centros de datos, la defensa y el sector aeroespacial. Así que la situación no es del todo catastrófica", añadió. Se espera que el Gobierno francés rebaje este viernes su propia previsión de crecimiento, que actualmente se sitúa en el 0,7%, mientras se prepara para remitir al Parlamento el proyecto de ley de presupuestos para 2027 a finales de mes.

item.title: In rialzo, ma verso forti ribassi settimanali
item.description: L'azionario europeo si avvia a chiudere la settimana con la peggiore performance da aprile, nonostante nella seduta odierna sia in lieve rialzo.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: L'azionario europeo si avvia a chiudere la settimana con la peggiore performance da aprile, nonostante nella seduta odierna sia in lieve rialzo. A pesare sul sentiment sono i rendimenti elevati dei titoli di Stato e i timori di un inasprimento aggressivo della politica monetaria, in attesa dei dati sull'inflazione statunitense. ** L'indice paneuropeo Stoxx 600 (.STOXX) guadagna lo 0,3% a 637,60 punti alle 9.40. ** Nella seduta di ieri l'indice ha toccato i minimi degli ultimi due mesi, dopo che la Banca centrale europea ha alzato i tassi come da attese, lanciando al contempo un allarme su nuove pressioni inflazionistiche legate al rincaro dell'energia, dovute al perdurare del conflitto in Medio Oriente. ** I prezzi del greggio restano sopra i 100 dollari al barile per il terzo giorno consecutivo. ** La posizione restrittiva della Bce richiama ulteriori aumenti dei tassi, mentre i rendimenti dei titoli di Stato in tutto il mondo registrano un'impennata. Il rendimento dei titoli del Treasury a 10 anni, riferimento chiave per i costi di indebitamento globali, si mantiene al di sotto della soglia del 5%, oggetto di grande attenzione. Anche il Bund tedesco a 10 anni si mantiene prossimo ai massimi degli ultimi decenni. ** Il focus degli investitori è ora puntato sui dati dell'indice dei prezzi al consumo statunitense, attesi in giornata, che potrebbero offrire indicazioni più chiare sulla traiettoria della politica monetaria della Federal Reserve in vista della riunione della prossima settimana. ** Tra i titoli azionari, la società italiana di test sui semiconduttori Technoprobe (TPRO.MI) avanza del 3,08% dopo che il suo cliente Tsmc ha pubblicato dati positivi sui ricavi di agosto.

item.title: Emma Bonino, Italian politician who fought for abortion access, dies aged 78
item.description: Emma Bonino's life in politics began with a crime. In 1974, at a time when abortion was illegal in Italy, she travelled to a clandestine clinic in Florence to terminate an unplanned pregnancy.
item.dc:creator: Crispian Balmer
item.content:encoded: Emma Bonino's life in politics began with a crime. In 1974, at a time when abortion was illegal in Italy, she travelled to a clandestine clinic in Florence to terminate an unplanned pregnancy. "Coming back by train at night, I decided that never, never, never again should anyone have to suffer this humiliation," she later recalled. A year later, determined to drag abortion out of the shadows, she handed herself in to the police, turning her private "offence" into a public act of defiance. The arrest made headlines, fueling a campaign that eventually led to the legalisation of abortion in 1978. It also launched Bonino into parliament with the Radical Party, a small but relentless force for civil rights. Direct and diminutive, Bonino was a passionate advocate for social justice and gender equality who deliberately courted controversy to advance her many causes at home and abroad. "I have been fighting for rights all my life, warning people to defend them, because they don't last forever," she told state broadcaster Rai in 2024. In a dynamic career spanning five decades, Bonino won repeated election to both the Italian and European parliaments and served as a foreign minister and European affairs minister in Rome. She was also a high-profile European Commissioner in Brussels. She remained in frontline politics well into her 70s, overcoming lung cancer despite refusing to give up smoking. Underscoring her high standing in Italy, and belying Roman Catholic disapproval of her stance on abortion, the then Pope Francis made an unusual trip outside the Vatican in November 2024 to visit her in her home after an acute health scare. She died on Friday aged 78, her spokesperson said. On Monday, Bonino was hospitalized in a serious condition, but was taken out of intensive care on Thursday and transferred to a private clinic. BRINGING COLOUR TO A GREY BRUSSELS Founded by Bonino's mentor, Marco Pannella, the Radical Party helped redraw Italian society, promoting an array of causes through acts of civil disobedience, hunger strikes and dozens of referendums. Some battles they won, such as banning nuclear power. In other campaigns, including a push to legalise cannabis, they fell short. To widespread surprise, Bonino was appointed to the European Commission in 1994, thanks to the backing of the then Italian Prime Minister Silvio Berlusconi. There she took charge of a disparate group of dossiers that no-one else had claimed - fisheries, consumer policy and the European Community's humanitarian office. She was the first woman ever to wear trousers at a meeting of the male-dominated Commission, and proved herself to be one of the most colourful politicians in an often grey Brussels. Accomplished and confident before the television cameras, she quickly drew media interest by riding Spanish fishing boats on the high seas during the EU's "fish war" with Canada. Not one to mince her words, she accused Canada of piracy, which that country's government denied. 'I DO NOT THINK WOMEN ARE A CATEGORY' In 1997 she was briefly detained by Taliban militia during a visit to Afghanistan after people in her party took pictures in a women's hospital - an offence under Taliban regulations. She condemned the international community's silence over the fate of Afghan women under the Taliban but told Reuters in 1996 that she did not see herself as a traditional feminist. "I do not want and I do not think that we women are a category," she said. "If we think we are a category to be protected, I think we will lose our fight." After her stint in Brussels, she pursued a broad mix of causes, including the campaign against female genital mutilation, pension equality in Italy and migrant rights. She also promoted closer integration across the European Union, founding the +Europa (More Europe) party in 2017. While she herself regularly scored well in popularity polls, her new party fared poorly at the ballot box, failing to win any seats at the 2019 and 2024 European parliamentary elections, while picking up just two seats at the 2022 national polls. Bonino, who was born in northwest Italy in 1948, never married and did not have children. "I didn't have them out of choice," she told Io Donna magazine in a 2018 interview. "You need a lot of courage (to have children). With a child you need to say 'for ever'. I never managed that." For more obituaries, click here .

item.title: Global 2026 oil supply gap to deepen on delayed return of normal Gulf flows, IEA says
item.description: Global oil supply and demand will fall further than previously thought this year, the International Energy Agency said on Friday, as a lack of progress in ending the Iran war delays the return of normal Middle East flows into 2027 and sends fuel prices soaring.
item.dc:creator: Alex Lawler
item.content:encoded: Global oil supply and demand will fall further than previously thought this year, the International Energy Agency said on Friday, as a lack of progress in ending the Iran war delays the return of normal Middle East flows into 2027 and sends fuel prices soaring. "Inventories have so far played a crucial role in balancing the market," the IEA, which advises industrialised countries, said in a monthly report. "With buffers shrinking and the global refining system stretched to the limit, the need for progress in resolving the conflict in the Middle East – and the Russia-Ukraine war, which is now in its fifth year – is greater than ever to avoid further market tightening."

item.title: Emma Bonino, storica leader radicale e paladina dei diritti civili, muore a 78 anni
item.description: L'ingresso di Emma Bonino in politica è cominciato con un reato: nel 1974, quando in Italia l'aborto era ancora illegale, si recò in una clinica clandestina a Firenze per interrompere una gravidanza indesiderata.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: L'ingresso di Emma Bonino in politica è cominciato con un reato: nel 1974, quando in Italia l'aborto era ancora illegale, si recò in una clinica clandestina a Firenze per interrompere una gravidanza indesiderata. "Tornando in treno di notte, decisi che mai, mai, mai più nessuno avrebbe dovuto subire un'umiliazione del genere", ricordò in seguito. Un anno dopo, determinata a portare il tema dell'aborto fuori dalla clandestinità, si autodenunciò alla polizia, trasformando il suo "reato" privato in un atto pubblico di sfida. L'arresto conquistò le prime pagine dei giornali e diede impulso a una campagna che avrebbe contribuito alla legalizzazione dell'aborto nel 1978. L'episodio aprì inoltre a Bonino la strada verso il Parlamento con il Partito Radicale, instancabile forza politica impegnata nella difesa dei diritti civili. "Ho lottato per tutta la vita per i diritti, mettendo in guardia le persone sulla necessità di difenderli, perché non durano per sempre", ha detto in un'intervista alla Rai nel 2024. Diretta nei modi e minuta nella statura, Bonino è stata una convinta sostenitrice della giustizia sociale e dell'uguaglianza di genere. È morta oggi all'età di 78 anni, come riferito da +Europa, il partito da lei fondato nel 2017, a testimonianza del suo impegno per una maggiore integrazione europea. "Emma ci ha lasciati ma non ci lascerà mai. Oggi non ci lascia soltanto la nostra leader, ci lascia una delle protagoniste più lucide, coraggiose e libere della storia politica del nostro Paese e del mondo libero", si legge in un post di +Europa su Facebook. DA ROMA A BRUXELLES, SEMPRE IN PRIMA LINEA Nel corso di una carriera lunga cinque decenni, Bonino è stata eletta più volte sia al Parlamento italiano sia a quello europeo e ha ricoperto gli incarichi di ministro degli Esteri e ministro per gli Affari europei. È stata inoltre una figura di primo piano della Commissione europea a Bruxelles. È rimasta in prima linea in politica ben oltre i 70 anni, superando un tumore ai polmoni, senza mai rinunciare al fumo. A testimonianza della sua autorevolezza in Italia, Papa Francesco nel novembre 2024, nonostante la opposte visioni sull'aborto, compì un'insolita visita fuori dal Vaticano per raggiungerla nella sua abitazione dopo un grave problema di salute. "Emma Bonino ha rappresentato per decenni una voce forte e riconoscibile della politica italiana, portando avanti le sue idee con determinazione. Le nostre storie e le nostre sensibilità sono state lontane, ma questo non mi ha mai impedito di riconoscerne il peso e il ruolo nella vita pubblica della nostra Nazione", ha scritto su X la premier Giorgia Meloni. PORTARE COLORE IN UNA BRUXELLES GRIGIA Fondato dal suo mentore, Marco Pannella, il Partito Radicale ha contribuito a ridisegnare la società italiana, promuovendo numerose cause attraverso atti di disobbedienza civile, scioperi della fame e decine di referendum. Alcune battaglie si sono concluse con una vittoria, come quella per lo stop all'energia nucleare. Altre, tra cui la campagna per la legalizzazione della cannabis, non hanno raggiunto l'obiettivo. Nel 1994 Bonino fu inaspettatamente nominata commissaria europea grazie al sostegno dell'allora presidente del Consiglio Silvio Berlusconi. Si trovò a gestire una serie eterogenea di deleghe che nessun altro aveva reclamato, tra cui pesca, tutela dei consumatori e l'ufficio per gli aiuti umanitari della Comunità europea. È stata la prima donna a presentarsi in pantaloni a una riunione della Commissione, allora dominata dagli uomini, e si è affermata come una delle personalità più vivaci e riconoscibili di una Bruxelles spesso percepita come grigia e burocratica. Sicura di sé davanti alle telecamere e abile comunicatrice, ha catturato rapidamente l'attenzione dei media salendo a bordo di pescherecci spagnoli durante la cosiddetta "guerra del pesce" tra Unione europea e Canada. Nota per il suo linguaggio schietto, accusò il Canada di pirateria, accusa respinta dal governo di Ottawa. "NON CREDO CHE LE DONNE SIANO UNA CATEGORIA" Nel 1997 venne brevemente fermata da miliziani talebani durante una visita in Afghanistan, dopo che esponenti del suo partito avevano scattato fotografie in un ospedale femminile, in violazione delle regole imposte dal regime. Bonino condannò il silenzio della comunità internazionale sulla condizione delle donne afghane sotto i Talebani, ma in un'intervista a Reuters del 1996 affermò di non considerarsi una femminista tradizionale. "Non voglio e non penso che noi donne siamo una categoria", disse. "Se pensiamo di essere una categoria da proteggere, credo che perderemo la nostra battaglia." Terminato l'incarico a Bruxelles, ha continuato a impegnarsi su molteplici fronti, tra cui la lotta contro le mutilazioni genitali femminili, l'uguaglianza nel sistema pensionistico italiano e i diritti dei migranti. Nonostante la sua popolarità, il nuovo partito ha raccolto risultati modesti alle urne, fallendo l'ingresso nel Parlamento europeo nel 2019 e nel 2024 e conquistando soltanto due seggi alle elezioni politiche del 2022. Bonino è nata nel 1948 a Bra, in provincia di Cuneo. Non si è mai sposata e non ha avuto figli. "Non li ho avuti per scelta", ha dichiarato in un'intervista a Io Donna nel 2018. "Per avere figli serve molto coraggio. Con un figlio bisogna dire 'per sempre'. Io non ci sono mai riuscita."

item.title: IEA further cuts Russian oil output forecasts on Ukrainian attacks
item.description: The International Energy Agency said on Friday it again revised down the outlook for Russia's oil production due to ongoing Ukrainian drone attacks on energy infrastructure.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: The International Energy Agency said on Friday it again revised down the outlook for Russia's oil production due to ongoing Ukrainian drone attacks on energy infrastructure. Crude output in Russia, the world's third-largest oil producer, has been declining amid Ukraine's strikes on the country's energy infrastructure, including oil refineries. The Paris-based IEA said in its monthly review that Russia's crude forecast was cut by 125,000 barrels per day to 8.7 million bpd in 2026 and by 235,000 bpd in 2027, when it is expected to average 8.6 million bpd. A [USN:L8N44P12J TEXT:"government draft forecast"] seen by Reuters last week showed Russia had downgraded the oil output outlook for this year to a 17-year low and revised the fuel exports outlook for 2026 and 2027 due to the conflict with Ukraine. According to the IEA, Russia's oil production declined last month by 200,000 barrels per day from July to 8.36 million bpd. That is a steep 940,000 bpd lower than the January 2026 peak of 9.3 million bpd and 695,000 bpd below year-ago levels, the IEA said. Russia stopped publishing data on oil output in April 2023, a little more than a year after the start of the conflict in Ukraine. The Organization of the Petroleum Exporting Countries said on Thursday that Russia's [USN:L1N4520C0 TEXT:"oil production declined"] by 160,000 bpd in August from July to 8.718 million bpd.

item.title: El BCE podría necesitar una política ligeramente restrictiva, según Nagel
item.description: El Banco Central Europeo podría necesitar subir aún más las tasas de interés y situarlas en un nivel que frene ligeramente la economía si continúa la subida de los precios de la energía provocada por la guerra, según dijo el viernes Joachim Nagel, miembro del Comité de Política Monetaria del BCE.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: El Banco Central Europeo podría necesitar subir aún más las tasas de interés y situarlas en un nivel que frene ligeramente la economía si continúa la subida de los precios de la energía provocada por la guerra, según dijo el viernes Joachim Nagel, miembro del Comité de Política Monetaria del BCE. El BCE subió el jueves los costes de financiación por segunda vez este año y los responsables de la política monetaria prevén un mayor endurecimiento de la política monetaria en los próximos meses, con una posible subida ya en octubre, según informaron dos fuentes a Reuters. Nagel señaló que el BCE había situado su tasa de interés de referencia, actualmente en el 2,50%, en el extremo superior de un rango neutral que ni estimula ni frena la economía. No obstante, podría ser necesario ir más allá. "No descarto que tengamos que entrar en un territorio ligeramente restrictivo, pero, como he dicho, depende en gran medida de cómo evolucionen los precios de la energía, de cómo se desarrolle la situación de los precios a lo largo, quizás, del próximo mes", dijo a la CNBC en una entrevista.

item.title: Mubadala deal orders short, strong shot of Luckin
item.description: The Abu Dhabi fund is taking a sip of the Chinese coffee company's rapid growth at home and overseas. The transaction, valued at $1 bln, softens any risks tied to the OTC-traded Starbucks rival, while allowing its private equity owner to raise cash without diluting its control.
item.dc:creator: Katrina Hamlin
item.content:encoded: Mubadala is placing a creative order at Luckin Coffee . The Abu Dhabi sovereign investor is taking a measured sip of the Chinese company, which is growing fast at home and overseas. The transaction, valued at $1 billion, softens any risks tied to the Starbucks (SBUX.O) rival, which trades over-the-counter in the U.S., while allowing its private equity owner to raise cash without diluting its control. It's a fresh endorsement for the coconut latte maker that was forced to delist from Nasdaq in 2020 after an accounting scandal and was, in 2022, snapped up by Beijing-based Centurium Capital. Mubadala is investing in a vehicle that will own 9.3% of the economic interest in Luckin, and the purchase will be financed by borrowings from pledging those same shares to banks as security. The upshot of the financial engineering, which implies a roughly 12% uplift on Luckin's $9.6 billion off-exchange market capitalisation, is two-fold. First, the buyer is making a leveraged bet risking less of its own cash, though how much is unclear. Second, the seller's 48% voting rights in Luckin remain intact, thanks to its super-voting stock. Mubadala will, nonetheless, get the right to appoint a member to the coffee company's board. Luckin has turned itself around despite weak consumption trends in China. Sales hit $2.3 billion in April to June, rising 28.5% from a year earlier, while its operating margin was 13.4%. Most of its more than 36,000 outlets are in the People's Republic. Its smaller overseas business is rapidly expanding too, including in New York. By contrast, Starbucks, which gave up control of its struggling China business earlier this year, saw same-store sales grow 7.9%, with a 10.4% margin last quarter. There's always a danger that customers lapping up Luckin's brews will go to rivals for their caffeine hit: companies like $9 billion Mixue (2097.HK) are offering bubble tea laced with tapioca pearls at cutthroat prices, giving Luckin a taste of the competition it is serving up to Starbucks. But if Luckin does remain on this growth trajectory, it may open the door for its hoped-for relisting. Abu Dhabi has found a way to order a short, strong shot, without splurging. Follow Katrina Hamlin on Bluesky and Linkedin . Mubadala Investment will make a minority investment in Luckin Coffee alongside the company’s controlling shareholder, private equity firm Centurium Capital, in a transaction valued at approximately $1 billion, the Abu Dhabi sovereign investor said on September 10. It is investing in a newly created vehicle that holds 241 million shares, equivalent to a 9.3% economic stake, in Luckin, an SEC filing showed. Financing for the transaction will come from bank loans, against which the shares will be pledged as security. The SEC filing did not disclose how much equity Mubadala is investing, nor the duo's respective economic interests in the vehicle. Under the terms of the deal, Mubadala will have the right to appoint a member of the Luckin board. Centurium, which holds about 48% of the voting rights in Luckin, first invested in Luckin in July 2018 but only took control of the company in 2022 after it was delisted from Nasdaq in 2020 following an accounting scandal. item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Bundesarbeitsministerin Bärbel Bas (SPD) hält an der geplanten Rentenreform fest, sagt für die Abschaffung des vorgezogenen Renteneintritts nach 45 Versicherungsjahren aber Übergangsregeln zu. Die Koalition müsse in dieser Wahlperiode die Rentenreform umsetzen, sagte Bas am Freitag in der Haushaltsdebatte des Bundestages. "Alles andere kommt uns teuer zu stehen, führt zu Rentenkürzungen und zu massiv steigenden Beiträgen." Mit Blick auf die Debatte um die Rente nach 45 Versicherungsjahren versprach Bas Übergangsregeln. "Es wird einen Vertrauensschutz geben, darauf können sich alle verlassen", sagte die SPD-Co-Chefin. Bas warb zudem für Instrumente, um den Arbeitsplatzabbau von Unternehmen im wirtschaftlichen Umbau abzufedern. Die Koalition werde sich darüber unterhalten müssen, "dass wir in Unternehmen, die unter Druck stehen, auch einen sozialverträglichen Abbau der Arbeitsplätze hinbekommen". Bas spielte damit offenkundig auf die Debatte über die Altersteilzeit an. Die Rentenkommission hatte die Abschaffung des Blockmodells vorgeschlagen. Dabei wird die verbleibende Beschäftigungszeit in zwei gleich lange Phasen geteilt. In der ersten arbeitet der Beschäftigte weiter in vollem Umfang, in der zweiten wird er vollständig von der Arbeit freigestellt. Wirtschaftsverbände wollen aber daran festhalten, da das Modell keinen Anreiz zur Frühverrentung setze, sondern ein wichtiges Instrument für eine sozialverträgliche Transformation sei.

item.title: Pound climbs after UK growth beats expectations
item.description: The pound rose slightly on Friday after data showed UK growth beat expectations in July, continuing a string of relatively upbeat readings for the British economy.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: The pound rose slightly on Friday after data showed UK growth [USN:L8N45309X TEXT:"beat expectations"] in July, continuing a string of relatively upbeat readings for the British economy. British gross domestic product grew 0.4% in July, figures from the Office for National Statistics showed, far outstripping economists' forecasts that the economy would flatline. Sterling rose 0.1% to $1.352 and climbed a similar amount against the euro. The euro zone's currency was down 0.1% against the pound to 85.84 pence. Growth was driven by the services sector, which expanded 0.4% month-on-month, the figures showed. Britain's economy expanded 1% in the first half of the year, the fastest growth in the G7, although some economists think issues with seasonal adjustments could mean the figure is overstated. That means it could beat the Bank of England's forecast of 1.1% growth in 2026, although some analysts think the data could be revised lower. Investment in AI is [USN:L8N44A0Z2 TEXT:"helping drive"] growth in sectors such as telecoms and information services, said Sanjay Raja, chief UK economist at Deutsche Bank. "The UK growth story is becoming harder to ignore," he said. "Households and businesses are still spending – despite the unfolding energy shock impacting disposable incomes." Britain's economy has fared better than expected in the face of rising energy costs due to the [USN:L6N45203X TEXT:"Iran war"], but the threat to growth still lingers, with Brent crude oil prices rising to $110 a barrel for the first time since May. The rise in energy costs has driven traders to ramp up their bets on interest rate hikes and helped send bond yields to multi-year or even multi-decade highs [USN:L4N4530DA TEXT:"around the world"]. Britain's benchmark 10-year yield rose to its [USN:L8N452109 TEXT:"highest since 2007"] on Thursday near 5.4% while the 30-year yield reached levels not seen since 1998 at almost 6%. Yields rise as prices fall and vice versa. Economists expect the Bank of England to hold interest rates at 3.75% at its meeting next week, but traders are almost fully pricing in a hike in November and expect roughly three more increases by the middle of 2027. However, BoE Governor [USN:L8N45019I TEXT:"Andrew Bailey"] on Tuesday said the market pricing showed a "risk premium" that reflected worries in the market about further energy price increases and that he wanted to dispel the idea that it is just a matter of time before the central bank raises interest rates.

item.description: Norway's energy ministry said on Friday it has received applications from 21 oil and gas companies seeking exploration acreage in the government's annual mature-areas (APA) licensing round.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Norway's energy ministry said on Friday it has received applications from 21 oil and gas companies seeking exploration acreage in the government's annual mature-areas (APA) licensing round. The number of companies rose by one from last year's APA round, as Shell (SHEL.L) made a comeback after being absent in 2025, the list of applicants showed. This year's round will contain 70 new blocks or parts of blocks to explore for oil and gas in the North Sea, the Norwegian Sea and the Barents Sea, the government [USN:L8N41I0V6 TEXT:"said in May"]. Equinor (EQNR.OL) , Aker BP (AKRBP.OL) , ConocoPhillips (COP.N) and TotalEnergies (TTEF.PA) were among the companies applying. "Continued exploration and new discoveries are crucial for Norway to remain a stable supplier of oil and gas," the energy ministry said in a statement.

item.content:encoded: Nach den Kursverlusten der vergangenen Tage hat der Dax (.GDAXI) am Freitag einen Erholungsversuch gestartet. Der deutsche Leitindex rückte um 0,5 Prozent auf 25.484 Punkte vor. Spekulationen auf eine baldige Zinserhöhung der US-Notenbank Fed und ein Ölpreissprung haben dem Dax in dieser Woche ein Minus von rund zweieinhalb Prozent beschert. "Die Angst vor einer Stagflation in den USA, also einem mauen Wirtschaftswachstum gepaart mit anziehenden Preisen, verdirbt den Hunger auf Aktien", sagte Andreas Lipkow, Chef-Marktanalyst CMC Markets. Mit Spannung erwarteten die Investoren am Nachmittag die US-Inflationsdaten für August. Experten gehen davon aus, dass die Verbraucherpreise wegen der hohen Energiepreise um 3,4 Prozent gestiegen sind. Die Daten gelten als entscheidend für den weiteren Zinskurs der US-Notenbank. Zuletzt hatten Äußerungen von Fed-Gouverneur Christopher Waller die Erwartung geschürt, dass die Notenbank bei unerwartet hohen Inflationszahlen bereits auf ihrer Sitzung in der kommenden Woche die Zinsen anheben könnte. Im Blick behielten die Investoren zudem die Ölpreise. Gewinnmitnahmen drückten die Notierungen für das Nordseeöl Brent und das US-Öl WTI am Freitag zwar um fast zwei Prozent auf 105,53 beziehungsweise 100,63 Dollar je Fass. Seit Montag haben die Preise wegen der zunehmenden Furcht vor langfristigen Versorgungsausfällen wegen des Konflikts im Nahen Osten jedoch um gut 13 Prozent zugelegt. Zu den größten Gewinnern im Dax zählten Siemens Energy (ENR1n.DE) und Airbus (AIRG.DE) mit einem Plus von jeweils mehr als einem Prozent. Auf der Verliererseite fand sich SAP (SAPG.DE) wieder, mit einem Abschlag von 1,3 Prozent. Ein Händler verwies auf den Quartalsbericht des Softwareunternehmens Adobe (ADBE.O) . Der US-Konzern übertraf zwar die Wall-Street-Schätzungen für den Umsatz im dritten Quartal, gab jedoch eine Umsatzprognose für das vierte Quartal ab, deren Mittelwert leicht unter den Erwartungen lag. Im MDax (.MDAXI) gerieten die Papiere von Flatexdegiro (FTKn.DE) ins Rutschen. Wie der Online-Broker am Donnerstagabend mitteilte, hat der Aufsichtsratsvorsitzende Hans-Hermann Lotter sein Amt mit sofortiger Wirkung niedergelegt. Die Aktien fielen in der Spitze um 10,9 Prozent.

item.title: Australian shares slump to two-month low as miners fall
item.description: Australian stocks ended Friday at a more than two-month low, as miners led by BHP lost on weaker commodity prices, while a surge in oil prices over the week heightened inflation concerns and kept investors on edge.
item.dc:creator: Keshav Singhchundawat
item.content:encoded: Australian stocks ended Friday at a more than two-month low, as miners led by BHP lost on weaker commodity prices, while a surge in oil prices over the week heightened inflation concerns and kept investors on edge. The benchmark S&P/ASX 200 index (.AXJO) fell 0.9% to 8,741.20 points, its lowest closing level since July 2. It lost 2.1% in the week, its steepest drop since mid-March. Global investors shunned risk assets on the day on fears that higher oil prices and persistent inflation fuelled by the Middle East war could prompt further policy tightening. "It's no surprise to see the market in a steep 'risk-off' mode with investors retreating to cash and defensive assets until we see some stability in the macroeconomic outlook," said Luke Winchester, portfolio manager at Merewether Capital. Heavyweight miners (.AXMM) slumped 3.7%, their steepest drop since June 19, as copper fell after [USN:L6N45210E TEXT:"Reuters"] reported that the White House has yet to decide on refined copper tariffs amid officials' concerns that higher prices for the metal could raise manufacturing costs. Major miner BHP (BHP.AX) slumped 4.1%, clocking its worst session since mid-June, while Rio Tinto (RIO.AX) shed 3.5%. Lithium miners Liontown (LTR.AX) and PLS (PLS.AX) tumbled 8.6% and 7.4%, respectively. Oil prices eased but were still set for a weekly gain, holding above $100 a barrel on fears of prolonged supply disruptions. Over the week, [USN:L1N4500AL TEXT:"hawkish signals"] from Reserve Bank of Australia governors, together with higher energy prices, increased expectations of further tightening. Markets are currently pricing in 32 basis points of rate hikes by November and 39 bps for December.0#AUDIRPR Yields on both short-term and long-term Australian government bonds jumped over the 5% mark to their highest levels since mid-2011 as a global bond selloff took hold. Limiting losses, financials (.AXFJ) advanced 1.1%, clocking their best session in nearly two weeks, after three straight sessions of losses. In New Zealand, benchmark S&P/NZX 50 index (.NZ50) fell 1% to 13,580.33 points, its lowest closing level since late-June. Investors are now awaiting the island nation's June-quarter GDP data to be released next week.

item.title: Österreichs Notenbank hebt Prognose für 2027 an - Inflation sinkt
item.description: Die Oesterreichische Nationalbank (OeNB) hat ihre Prognose für das Wirtschaftswachstum 2027 trotz des Krieges im Nahen und Mittleren Osten und einer schweren Sommerdürre erhöht. Das Bruttoinlandsprodukt (BIP) dürfte im kommenden Jahr um 1,3 Prozent zulegen und damit um 0,2 Prozentpunkte stärker wachsen als noch im Juni prognostiziert, teilte die OeNB am Freitag mit. Für das laufende Jahr senkten die Experten ihre Prognose wegen einer schwachen ersten Jahreshälfte leicht um 0,1 Prozentpunkte auf 0,5 Prozent. Für das zweite Halbjahr seien die Aussichten jedoch besser. Die Exportwirtschaft dürfte von einem stärkeren Welthandel profitieren. Zudem hätten sich Auftragslage und Stimmung in der Industrie verbessert. Zwar dämpfe die Dürre das Wachstum 2026 um 0,1 Prozentpunkte, insgesamt überwögen trotz der schwierigen Rahmenbedingungen jedoch die positiven Signale, sagte OeNB-Gouverneur Martin Kocher. Für 2028 geht die Notenbank unverändert von einem Wachstum von 1,2 Prozent aus.

Für das laufende Jahr senkten die Experten ihre Prognose wegen einer schwachen ersten Jahreshälfte leicht um 0,1 Prozentpunkte auf 0,5 Prozent. Für das zweite Halbjahr seien die Aussichten jedoch besser. Die Exportwirtschaft dürfte von einem stärkeren Welthandel profitieren. Zudem hätten sich Auftragslage und Stimmung in der Industrie verbessert. Zwar dämpfe die Dürre das Wachstum 2026 um 0,1 Prozentpunkte, insgesamt überwögen trotz der schwierigen Rahmenbedingungen jedoch die positiven Signale, sagte OeNB-Gouverneur Martin Kocher. Für 2028 geht die Notenbank unverändert von einem Wachstum von 1,2 Prozent aus. Auch bei der Teuerung erwartet die OeNB einen deutlichen Rückgang, warnt jedoch vor geopolitischen Risiken. Im Basisszenario soll die Inflationsrate von 3,0 Prozent im laufenden Jahr auf 2,3 Prozent 2027 und 2,2 Prozent 2028 sinken. Sollten sich die Energie- und Nahrungsmittelpreise infolge des Nahost-Konflikts allerdings deutlich verteuern, könnte die Inflation im kommenden Jahr auf bis zu 5,6 Prozent steigen. In eine Rezession würde Österreich selbst in diesem ungünstigsten Szenario nicht abrutschen: Das Wirtschaftswachstum läge dann 2027 immer noch bei 0,3 Prozent. Mit Blick auf die Basisprognose erklärte Kocher, der Inflationsabstand zum Euroraum verringere sich deutlich. Die heimische Teuerung werde sich künftig weitgehend im Gleichklang mit dem Euroraum entwickeln. Maßgeblich für den Rückgang sei insbesondere das Auslaufen der Effekte des Energiepreisschocks infolge des Nahost-Krieges, hieß es weiter. Zudem dämpfe eine im Juli eingeführte Mehrwertsteuersenkung auf ausgewählte Lebensmittel die Inflation und überwiege zunächst den Preisdruck durch die Dürre.

item.title: Sian Heder "visibiliza a los invisibles" con una película sobre las personas con discapacidad
item.description: La película "Being Heumann", de la oscarizada Sian Heder, inauguró el festival de Toronto con una conmovedora historia sobre cómo personas con discapacidad, gracias a su voluntad indomable, su valentía y su compromiso, lograron lo imposible.
item.dc:creator: Bhargav Acharya
item.content:encoded: La película "Being Heumann", de la oscarizada Sian Heder, inauguró el festival de Toronto con una conmovedora historia sobre cómo personas con discapacidad, gracias a su voluntad indomable, su valentía y su compromiso, lograron lo imposible. "Being Heumann" narra la historia de Judy Heumann, la fallecida activista estadounidense —conocida popularmente como la "madre del movimiento por los derechos de las personas con discapacidad"—, que lideró a un grupo de personas con discapacidad en su lucha contra la apatía y la discriminación, lo que dio lugar a la ocupación más prolongada de un edificio federal en la historia de Estados Unidos. "Lideró a un grupo de 100 personas con discapacidad que entraron en un edificio federal y lo ocuparon hasta que se aprobó la primera ley sobre los derechos de las personas con discapacidad. Por eso es alguien a quien todo el mundo debería conocer", dijo Heder a Reuters en la alfombra roja antes del estreno de la película en el Festival Internacional de Cine de Toronto. "Creo que toda su labor se centró en cómo visibilizar a las personas invisibles y arrojar luz sobre ellas, y no solo eso, sino lograr el difícil cambio que supone la inclusión, y eso es lo que estamos haciendo aquí", dijo Heder. La guionista y directora Heder ganó el Óscar al mejor guion adaptado en 2022 por su película "CODA", una historia de madurez sobre la única persona oyente de una familia de sordos. Daniel Durant, que recibió elogios de la crítica por su papel en esa película, no dudó en aprovechar la oportunidad de volver a trabajar con Heder. "Es una auténtica maga y eso se nota en la pantalla", afirmó. La sentada de San Francisco de 1977 duró 26 días y obligó al entonces secretario de Salud, Educación y Bienestar de EEUU, Joseph Califano Jr., a firmar la normativa que aplicaba la Sección 504 de la Ley de Rehabilitación de 1973, que garantizaba el acceso a las personas con discapacidad. La actriz británica Ruth Madeley interpreta a Heumann, mientras que la estrella estadounidense Mark Ruffalo da vida a Califano. La mayor parte del reparto de la película está formado por actores con discapacidad. "Creo que incorporar tantas facetas diferentes de Judy a la película… La gente la conoce como esa activista tenaz que cambió el mundo, así que poder mostrar su lado divertido, su lado desenfrenado, su humor, su alegría, todo, es realmente especial y significativo", dijo Madeley. La película se estrenará en cines seleccionados el 6 de noviembre, antes de estar disponible en Apple TV una semana después.

item.title: US listing could put Japan's Kioxia in global AI spotlight, Voya's Thomas says
item.description: A plan by Kioxia to list shares in the United States could put the Japanese chipmaker back into the global investment spotlight, said the lead manager of a $14 billion AI-focused fund.
item.dc:creator: Rocky Swift, Miho Uranaka
item.content:encoded: A plan by Kioxia (285A.T) to list shares in the United States could put the Japanese [USN:L4N4330KT TEXT:"chipmaker"] back into the global investment spotlight, said the lead manager of a $14 billion [USN:L4N44601E TEXT:"AI-focused"] fund. [USN:L1N41S08U TEXT:"Kioxia"], whose 456% surge this year leads gains on the benchmark Nikkei 225 index, said in May it was making preparations to list American depositary Shares (ADS) to grow its investor base. The company is not a part of Voya Investments' Global Artificial Intelligence fund, which includes $5 billion in Japanese money, nor are any of the tech firms that have fuelled the Nikkei's gains. The problem is liquidity, said Voya portfolio manager Sebastian Thomas, and being traded in the U.S. market could change that calculus, as it did with South Korea's SK Hynix (000660.KS) when it listed on the Nasdaq in July. "There are a lot of interesting companies in Japan, particularly that are part of the supply chain," Thomas said in an interview with Reuters on Thursday. "It's an issue of finding ones that have sufficient liquidity where we can invest." The fund, which is affiliated with Sumitomo Mitsui DS Asset Management, has given about 600% in cumulative returns since its launch 10 years ago this month, calculated on a pre-tax distribution-reinvested basis. It invests in AI [USN:L4N44O0GS TEXT:"infrastructure"] companies like chipmaker Nvidia (NVDA.O) , the fund's heaviest weighting, but also AI application makers and companies that stand to benefit by embracing the technology, such as drugmaker Eli Lilly (LLY.N) . Voya has invested in Japanese names in the past, and while it doesn't hold Kioxia, it has exposure to other memory makers, including SK Hynix and Micron Technology (MU.O) , Thomas said, adding that U.S. listings make that entry easier. "We tend to skew a bit more liquid and larger," he said.

item.title: Ataques entre Rusia y Ucrania dejan muertos y heridos en Tula, Kiev y Volgogrado
item.description: Al menos dos personas murieron en un ataque con drones ucranianos contra la región rusa de Tula, mientras que ocho resultaron heridas en los ataques aéreos rusos que provocaron un incendio en un bloque de viviendas de nueve plantas en Kiev el viernes por la mañana, según las autoridades.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Al menos dos personas murieron en un ataque con drones ucranianos contra la región rusa de Tula, mientras que ocho resultaron heridas en los ataques aéreos rusos que provocaron un incendio en un bloque de viviendas de nueve plantas en Kiev el viernes por la mañana, según las autoridades. Ucrania, que lleva defendiéndose de Rusia desde febrero de 2022, afirma que los ataques forman parte de una campaña para "llevar la guerra a casa" de los rusos de a pie y aumentar el coste que supone para Moscú continuar con el conflicto. Tanto Rusia como Ucrania niegan que sus ataques tengan como objetivo a la población civil. Rusia reanudó esta semana sus ataques aéreos casi constantes contra Kiev tras una breve pausa durante la visita a Moscú y Kiev de los negociadores del presidente estadounidense Donald Trump, que buscaban poner fin a la guerra que el Kremlin inició al invadir Ucrania en 2022. Las imágenes de Reuters mostraban a militares tratando de apagar un incendio en un bloque de pisos de Kiev en el que varias ventanas habían quedado destrozadas. En Rusia, el gobernador de la región de Tula, Dmitri Milyayev, dijo en Telegram que dos personas habían fallecido y otras tres habían resultado heridas en ataques con drones durante la noche. Los drones ucranianos también causaron daños en infraestructuras civiles en la ciudad de Saratov, situada en la cuenca central del río Volga, informó el gobernador regional, Roman Busargin, a través de Telegram, agregó que no hubo víctimas. La empresa rusa de comercio electrónico Ozon afirmó en Telegram que un ataque con drones ucranianos provocó un incendio en su centro logístico de Saratov, lo que se suma a las más de dos decenas de almacenes, propiedad de Ozon y de su principal competidor, Wildberries, que han sido atacados recientemente. La región de Saratov, objetivo frecuente de los ataques aéreos ucranianos —incluido uno a principios de esta semana—, alberga una gran refinería de petróleo gestionada por la empresa estatal Rosneft (ROSN.MM) , así como otras instalaciones industriales y militares. En la ciudad de Volgogrado, al sur de Saratov y también situada a orillas del río Volga, un ataque con misiles dejó dos heridos tras impactar en dos edificios residenciales, y los escombros también causaron daños en una instalación industrial, informaron las autoridades locales a través de Telegram. Afirmaron que se habilitó un refugio provisional en una escuela para acoger a las personas de las viviendas dañadas. La publicación no dio detalles sobre la instalación industrial. La refinería de petróleo de Volgogrado, gestionada por Lukoil (LKOH.MM) —una de las mayores de Rusia por capacidad de procesamiento—, se encuentra en las afueras de la ciudad. Reuters no ha podido verificar de inmediato estas informaciones.

item.title: Portugal backs using frozen Russian assets for Ukraine, understands Belgian concerns
item.description: Portugal supports using frozen Russian assets to aid Ukraine but understands Belgium's demand for EU-wide guarantees against potential financial risks, Foreign Minister Paulo Rangel said.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Portugal supports using frozen Russian assets to aid Ukraine but understands Belgium's demand for EU-wide guarantees against potential financial risks, Foreign Minister Paulo Rangel said. Most of the roughly €200 billion ($232.54 billion) in frozen Russian assets held in Europe are kept at [USN:L8N4321A2 TEXT:"Brussels-based clearing house Euroclear"], placing Belgium at the centre of the debate over whether the funds should be used to support Ukraine. The European Commission last year proposed using the assets to back a loan for Ukraine. But Belgium rejected the plan, saying it lacked guarantees against potential lawsuits and Russian compensation claims, insisting the risks be shared across the European Union. "Portugal is favourable and will never be an obstacle to the use of those €200 billion," Rangel told a parliamentary committee late on Thursday, adding that if a European consensus emerged in favour of using them, Portugal would align itself with that position. Belgium's concerns and its call for EU-wide guarantees were "truly pertinent", however, he said, arguing that any arrangement that left it bearing a disproportionate share of the legal or financial risks could undermine the country's credibility in international markets. Rangel said he hoped a "very constructive solution" could be found, while acknowledging that difficulties remained in securing guarantees for Belgium because some EU member states were seeking greater clarity on the financial framework. ($1 = 0.8601 euros)

item.title: Nagel: EZB könnte mit einem höheren Leitzins Konjunktur etwas dämpfen
item.description: Bundesbankchef Joachim Nagel schließt nicht aus, dass die EZB die Zinszügel weiter anziehen muss und damit auch die Wirtschaft leicht bremsen würde. Es sei noch zu früh, um über Zinserhöhungen zu spekulieren, sagte Nagel am Freitag dem Sender CNBC. Dies hänge letztlich von der Entwicklung der Energiepreise ab. Er könne jedoch nicht ausschließen, dass die Notenbank mit einem strafferen Kurs auch in einen leicht "restriktiven Bereich" vordringe. Damit ist ein Zinsniveau gemeint, das die Wirtschaft etwas dämpft. Die Europäische Zentralbank hatte den Leitzins am Donnerstag auf 2,50 Prozent angehoben. Nagel sagte, damit sei er an der Obergrenze einer neutralen geldpolitischen Zone angesiedelt - also in einem Bereich, in dem die Wirtschaft weder gebremst noch angeschoben wird.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Bundesbankchef Joachim Nagel schließt nicht aus, dass die EZB die Zinszügel weiter anziehen muss und damit auch die Wirtschaft leicht bremsen würde. Es sei noch zu früh, um über Zinserhöhungen zu spekulieren, sagte Nagel am Freitag dem Sender CNBC. Dies hänge letztlich von der Entwicklung der Energiepreise ab. Er könne jedoch nicht ausschließen, dass die Notenbank mit einem strafferen Kurs auch in einen leicht "restriktiven Bereich" vordringe. Damit ist ein Zinsniveau gemeint, das die Wirtschaft etwas dämpft. Die Europäische Zentralbank hatte den Leitzins am Donnerstag auf 2,50 Prozent angehoben. Nagel sagte, damit sei er an der Obergrenze einer neutralen geldpolitischen Zone angesiedelt - also in einem Bereich, in dem die Wirtschaft weder gebremst noch angeschoben wird. Der Bundesbankchef nannte es zugleich eine gute Nachricht, dass sich die Wirtschaft trotz der Folgen des Iran-Krieges als erstaunlich robust erweise. Für Deutschland, die größte Volkswirtschaft des Euroraums, könne dieses Jahr ein Wirtschaftswachstum von rund einem Prozent herausspringen. Die EZB hat ihre Konjunkturprognosen für die Euro-Zone für dieses und kommendes Jahr jüngst heraufgesetzt. 2026 soll das Bruttoinlandsprodukt um 0,9 (bisher: 0,8) Prozent steigen, während für 2027 nun 1,4 (bisher: 1,2) Prozent erwartet werden. "Darin spiegelt sich hauptsächlich wider, dass die Widerstandsfähigkeit der Wirtschaft des Euroraums stärker ist als erwartet", erklärte die EZB. Die Währungshüter warnten zugleich vor anhaltendem Preisdruck, was Spekulationen über weitere Zinserhöhungen befeuerte. Der Ölpreis war Mitte der Woche wieder über die psychologisch wichtige Marke von 100 Dollar je Barrel gesprungen. Der eskalierende Konflikt zwischen den USA und dem Iran schürt an den Börsen die Sorge vor Lieferausfällen. Die EZB will verhindern, dass der Ölpreisschock das Preisgefüge im Euroraum nachhaltig verändert: Denn die hohen Energiekosten für Konsumenten und Firmen bergen die Gefahr, dass eine Lohn-Preis-Spirale in Gang kommt und sich die starke Teuerung so verfestigt.

item.title: German corporate insolvencies hit 13-year high in first half
item.description: The number of corporate insolvencies in Germany rose to a 13-year high in the first half of 2026 despite signs of a nascent recovery in Europe's largest economy, figures from the federal statistics office showed on Friday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: The number of corporate insolvencies in Germany rose to a 13-year high in the first half of 2026 despite signs of a nascent recovery in Europe's largest economy, figures from the federal statistics office showed on Friday. Local courts reported 12,812 corporate insolvency filings from January to June, an increase of 6.7% year-on-year, with transportation and warehousing the most affected sectors. The last time a higher figure was recorded for the first half was in 2013, with 13,253 cases. Local courts estimated creditors' claims arising from the corporate insolvencies at around €18.5 billion ($21.5 billion). That is significantly less than the €28.2 billion reported for the same period last year, when more economically significant companies went insolvent. Consumer insolvencies also rose slightly, by 2.4%, for a total of 38,932 cases. Germany's economy has recently regained its footing, expanded more strongly in the second [USN:L8N44M0D2 TEXT:"quarter"] than initially estimated, while [USN:L8N44M0D2 TEXT:"business morale"] rose to its highest level in a year in August. ($1 = 0.8615 euros)

item.title: Las bolsas europeas suben, pero se encaminan hacia fuertes caídas semanales
item.description: Las acciones europeas subían ligeramente el viernes, pero parecían encaminadas a registrar su peor evolución semanal desde abril, en un momento en que los elevados rendimientos de los bonos y los temores ante unas subidas agresivas de las tasas de interés empañaban el ánimo de los inversionistas a la espera de los datos clave sobre la inflación en EEUU .
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Las acciones europeas subían ligeramente el viernes, pero parecían encaminadas a registrar su peor evolución semanal desde abril, en un momento en que los elevados rendimientos de los bonos y los temores ante unas subidas agresivas de las tasas de interés empañaban el ánimo de los inversionistas a la espera de los datos clave sobre la inflación en EEUU . El índice paneuropeo STOXX 600 (.STOXX) subía un 0,3%, hasta los 637,60 puntos, a las 0716 GMT. El índice cerró el jueves en su mínimo de los últimos dos meses después de que el Banco Central Europeo [USN:L6N4520S6 TEXT:"subiera "][USN:L6N4520S6 TEXT:"las tasas"] de interés, tal y como se esperaba, y advirtiera de un aumento de la inflación debido al alza de los precios de la energía a raíz del prolongado conflicto en Oriente Medio. Los precios del [USN:L6N4530EL TEXT:"petróleo"] se cotizaban por encima de los 100 dólares por tercer día consecutivo. La postura restrictiva del BCE ha suscitado [USN:L6N4530GX TEXT:"llamamientos"] a nuevas subidas de tasas, mientras que los rendimientos de la deuda pública en todo el mundo se han disparado. El rendimiento de los bonos del Tesoro estadounidense a 10 años, un referente para los costos de financiación a nivel mundial, se mantenía por debajo del nivel del 5%, que se sigue muy de cerca. El rendimiento alemán a 10 años seguía cerca de máximos de varias décadas. La atención de los inversionistas se centrará en las cifras del índice de precios al consumo de EEUU, que se publicarán este viernes y que podrían ofrecer nuevas señales sobre la trayectoria de las tasas de interés de la Reserva Federal de cara a la reunión de política monetaria de la próxima semana. En cuanto a las acciones, la empresa italiana de pruebas de semiconductores Technoprobe (TPRO.MI) se disparó un 4,7% después de que su cliente TSMC anunciara unos sólidos ingresos en agosto.

item.title: La postura restrictiva del BCE suscita llamados a nuevas subidas de las tasas de interés
item.description: Goldman Sachs, Citigroup y Barclays prevén que el Banco Central Europeo endurezca aún más su política monetaria, ya que el nuevo repunte de los precios de la energía suscita inquietudes sobre si la inflación volverá a situarse cerca del objetivo.
item.dc:creator: Rashika Singh
item.content:encoded: Goldman Sachs, Citigroup y Barclays prevén que el Banco Central Europeo endurezca aún más su política monetaria, ya que el nuevo repunte de los precios de la energía suscita inquietudes sobre si la inflación volverá a situarse cerca del objetivo. El banco central [USN:L6N4520S6 TEXT:"subió el jueves"] las tasas de interés oficiales en 25 puntos básicos, tal y como se esperaba, y pronosticó que la inflación se mantendría por encima del objetivo del 2% durante un periodo prolongado. El conflicto en Oriente Medio, que ya dura seis meses, ha empeorado las perspectivas de inflación y crecimiento de la zona del euro, mientras que la reanudación de las hostilidades entre Estados Unidos e Irán ha impulsado los precios del crudo por encima de los 100 dólares el barril, lo que amenaza con ejercer nuevas presiones al alza sobre los precios al consumo. Aunque Goldman Sachs, Citi y Barclays afirman que el BCE volverá a subir las tasas en diciembre, Citi prevé una subida adicional en marzo de 2027. "Cuanto más tiempo se mantenga alta la inflación, más pronunciados serán los riesgos de que se convierta en endógena", afirmaron los economistas de Citi. El BCE ha subido los costos de financiación de forma agresiva en los últimos años en un intento por frenar la inflación, aunque sus dirigentes han insistido cada vez más en que las decisiones de política monetaria seguirán dependiendo de los datos macroeconómicos. El banco central se reunirá de nuevo el 29 de octubre. Barclays señaló que la subida de tasas "obvia" del BCE ponía de relieve el enfoque continuado de los dirigentes monetarios en controlar la inflación, que el banco central no espera que vuelva al objetivo hasta finales de 2027. Goldman Sachs afirmó que una subida en diciembre situaría las tasas de interés en un "territorio ligeramente restrictivo". Según datos de LSEG, los operadores descuentan una probabilidad del 93,9% de que el BCE suba las tasas un cuarto de punto en diciembre. La atención se centra también en las tan esperadas reuniones de la Reserva Federal y del Banco de Japón de la próxima semana, que podrían reforzar el contexto de endurecimiento monetario a nivel mundial si los responsables de política monetaria dan señales de que las tasas se mantendrán altas durante más tiempo.

item.title: South African rand edges up before US inflation data
item.description: The South African rand edged up in early trade on Friday, ahead of the release of a key U.S. inflation report later in the day.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: The South African rand edged up in early trade on Friday, ahead of the release of a key U.S. inflation report later in the day. At 0725 GMT the rand traded at 16.16 against the dollar , 0.3% stronger than its previous close. Global investor focus is on U.S. inflation data due at 1230 GMT, as it could [USN:L6N4520TJ TEXT:"shape the case"] for a Federal Reserve rate hike next week. On Wednesday, data showed U.S. [USN:L1N4500SJ TEXT:"producer prices"] increased 0.4% in August, meeting market expectations as energy prices rebounded during the month. The U.S. dollar last traded flat against a basket of currencies. Oil prices [USN:L1N45303L TEXT:"fell"] on Friday but both major benchmarks are on track to end the week above $100 a barrel for the first time since mid-May, as increasing attacks along key shipping routes in the Middle East fuel fears of a prolonged disruption to supplies. In common with other risk-sensitive currencies, the rand often takes cues from global drivers such as U.S. economic indicators and monetary policy. On the Johannesburg Stock Exchange, the Top-40 index (.JTOPI) was up 0.3%. South Africa's benchmark 2035 government bond weakened in early deals, as the yield rose 5.5 basis points to 8.76%.

item.title: China, India arranging meeting for Xi, Modi, China's foreign ministry says
item.description: China and India are arranging for a bilateral meeting between Chinese President Xi Jinping and Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi, China's foreign ministry said on Friday, as Xi is set to travel to India this weekend to attend a BRICS summit.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: China and India are arranging for a bilateral meeting between Chinese President Xi Jinping and Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi, China's foreign ministry said on Friday, as Xi is set to travel to India this weekend to attend a BRICS summit. China is willing to approach bilateral ties "from a strategic and long-term perspective," enhance communication and cooperation while properly managing differences, said Mao Ning, a ministry spokesperson, during a regular press conference. Xi will attend the BRICS summit, address the event and have in-depth exchanges with leaders on the current international situation, Mao said.

item.title: Austrian central bank says economic outlook improving, to be felt next year
item.description: Austria's central bank has trimmed its economic growth forecast for the country in 2026 due to a weaker-than-expected first six months of the year, but raised it for next year as the outlook is improving, it said on Friday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Austria's central bank has trimmed its economic growth forecast for the country in 2026 due to a weaker-than-expected first six months of the year, but raised it for next year as the outlook is improving, it said on Friday. In an update to its last economic forecasts [USN:L8N42K06D TEXT:"published in June"], the Austrian National Bank (OeNB) said it now expects gross domestic product to grow by 0.5% this year, 0.1 points less than it had previously predicted. It raised its forecast for 2027, however, to 1.3% from 1.1%. "Despite the war in the Middle East and this summer's drought, the economic outlook for the second half of 2026 has improved," the ONB said in a statement. "Global trade grew more strongly than expected, which should also benefit the Austrian export sector. At the same time, the order-book situation and sentiment in the domestic manufacturing sector have improved," it said, adding that the effects of those would mainly be felt next year. The central bank trimmed its forecast for Austrian inflation according to the Harmonised Index Of Consumer Prices (HICP) to 3% this year from 3.2%, and to 2.3% next year from 2.4%.

item.title: European stocks rise but head for sharp weekly declines
item.description: European stocks edged higher on Friday but looked on course for their worst weekly performance since April as high bond yields and fears about aggressive interest rate hikes tempered sentiment ahead of key U.S. inflation data.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: European stocks edged higher on Friday but looked on course for their worst weekly performance since April as high bond yields and fears about aggressive interest rate hikes tempered sentiment ahead of key U.S. inflation data. The pan-European STOXX 600 (.STOXX) rose 0.3% to 637.60 points by 0716 GMT. The index closed at a two-month low on Thursday after [USN:L8N45111M TEXT:"the European Central Bank raised interest rates"] as expected and warned of higher inflation as energy prices soar in the wake of a prolonged Middle East conflict. Oil prices were trading above $100 for a third day. The ECB's hawkish stance has [USN:L4N45308V TEXT:"prompted calls"] for further rate hikes, while government bond yields across the globe have surged. The U.S. 10-year Treasury yield, a benchmark for global borrowing costs, hovered below the closely watched 5% level. The German 10-year yield stayed near multi-decade highs. Investor attention will be on U.S. Consumer Price Index figures due later in the day, which could provide fresh signals on the Federal Reserve's interest rate path ahead of a monetary policy meeting next week. Among stocks, Italian semiconductor testing company Technoprobe (TPRO.MI) jumped 4.7% as its customer TSMC posted strong August revenue.
